title: Instant Payouts on Northloop Payments: Availability and Daily Limits
content:
**Terms.** Instant payouts are available only on plans that offer instant payouts and only from the payable amount. ~~Each instant payout bears a fee of the instant fee rate times the amount, but never less than the instant minimum fee.~~ That fee sentence is **no longer in force**; the instant payout fee is governed by the current instant payout fee basis of Northloop Payments. The instant payouts of one calendar day may not exceed the plan's daily limit in total or its maximum count.

## What the terms in force require

| Requirement | Reading |
|---|---|
| Plan offers instant payouts | the payout plan offers instant payouts to an eligible debit card |
| Source of the funds | the payable amount only, never reserved funds |
| Daily total | the sum of the account's instant payouts dated the handling day may not exceed the plan's daily limit |
| Daily count | the number of the account's instant payouts dated the handling day may not exceed the plan's maximum count |

The day is the calendar day of the handling date; both the count and the total are taken over the instant payouts of the account dated that day.

## Hypothetical illustrations

- On Payments Daily Plus (daily limit 5000.00 USD, at most 5 per day), an account that has sent instant payouts of 3000.00 USD and 1500.00 USD today has a total of 4500.00 USD and a count of 2; a further 800.00 USD would take the day's total to 5300.00 USD, above the daily limit.
- On Payments Weekly no instant payout is available, because the plan does not offer instant payouts.

superseded_clauses: Each instant payout bears a fee of the instant fee rate times the amount, but never less than the instant minimum fee.
